anf_compare.notes: No public-domain English of On Pascha exists (Toura 1941; Daly ACW 54 and Witte's German are copyrighted and were not copied). Sense checked against the locked Witte Greek (and, for 1.94, Victor of Capua's Latin as Witte prints it) and the wording of the cited scriptures.

apparatus: Mostly unrestored or heavily restored Greek; English does not fill gaps.

bible_refs.note: Quoted: seeing I have seen the affliction… I have come down to deliver…
To the land sworn to the fathers.
Deliverance from Egypt; the sworn land.

choices.why: One of three pagan accounts of the bounds; keep the triad.

pass_a_gloss: For he has given back [gap] being held by ignorance to the bounds according to them, some by fate, some by chance, some by the ruler's rule, because of the rearing toward him in a time of infancy as they were reared, having forgotten the according-to-nature mother and the true Father who said: Seeing I have seen the hurting of my people the one in Egypt, and I have heard their cry and I have come down to take them out from the taskmasters and from the slavery of Pharaoh to take them out and from hand of the Egyptians and to lead them into the land of the fathers, which I swore to Abraham and to Isaac and to Jacob to give them in a lot,
pass_b_english: For he has given back [...] being held by ignorance to the bounds according to them — some by fate, some by chance, some by the rule of the ruler — because of the rearing toward him in a time of infancy, as they were reared, having forgotten the mother according to nature and the true Father who said: "Seeing I have seen the affliction of my people who are in Egypt, and I have heard their cry and I have come down to deliver them from the taskmasters and to deliver them from the slavery of Pharaoh and from the hand of the Egyptians and to bring them into the land of the fathers, which I swore to Abraham and to Isaac and to Jacob to give them as an inheritance," (Exodus 3:7–8) (Exodus 3:17) (Exodus 6:6–8) (Genesis 15:18)
